title: Direct hop with both ends stationary: one kept link-hour
reasoning: Each receipt is a radio receipt (via_mqtt false) at c01-g with relay_node 20, which is the sender c01-r's own low byte, so it is a direct hop: the relayer is c01-r and link_source is relay_node (lnk_01, step 1).
The relayer is not the gateway (lnk_03) and every RSSI and SNR is in range (lnk_06).

Each of c01-r (20-bit cell r20) and c01-g (16-bit cell g16) has one usable position inside the MSA in the 7 days before every receipt, so it is stationary with that position's cell as its box, and the hour's box is the same cell (lnk_02, steps 4 to 6).

Distance between the box centres, which are the stored values for cells of 1 to 31 bits: 2745.603 m, inside 500 to 60 000 m, and the two cells' longitude intervals are disjoint, so they do not overlap (lnk_05, step 7).
One box per end, 3 packets, median distance at least 500 m: kept (steps 8 to 10).
Medians over the counted receipts: SNR 5, 6 and 7 dB give 6.0; RSSI -90, -95 and -100 dBm give -95.0 (lnk_04, percentile_cont).
position_uncertainty_m is the larger half-width of each end's box, r20 22.734410 m plus g16 363.750397 m, = 386.484807 m (lnk_05).
Neither end is precise: r20 was sent on the public broker only, and g16 has fewer than 20 bits (pos_04).

lnk_07: the link geometry is a valid two-point LINESTRING between r20's centre (-90.3657472, 38.6000896) and g16's centre (-90.3970816, 38.5974272), compared as the README's Comparison says; every kept hour is checked the same way. lnk_08: one row for (c01-r, c01-g, 10:00).
